mapper.select: SELECT ci.id AS cart_item_id, sku.product_id, ci.sku_id, ci.quantity, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, p.name AS product_name, p.subtitle AS product_subtitle, p.image_path AS product_image_path, sku.price, sku.original_price, sku.unit, sku.stock, p.status AS product_status, sku.status AS sku_status FROM cart_item ci INNER JOIN product_sku sku ON sku.id = ci.sku_id INNER JOIN mall_product p ON p.id = sku.product_id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.updated_at DESC, ci.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, sku_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
